## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** CR, DEP, NCSV (rule heads, baselines, all 13 declared factor ladders incl. untriggered tiers, assemblies, overwrites/retired surface, three prerequisites, tool contracts) and the governing base policies correspond at the level of entailment. First revision.

Policy-side note: the base whole_dividends formula `accumulation_interest = balance × rate` survives as a formula while its clause is retired; the KB retires "its interest figure of the balance times the declared rate" together with the clause, matching the overwrite's intent; the extended baseline restates the same product as the CR baseline, so no conflict arises.

## dependency_form

Hop marks from the blind answer: Q1←Q2, Q1←Q3, Q2←Q3, all state-derived; none pre-solved.

Checked and clean: prerequisite sentences verbatim on the blocked side only (DEP hub; NCSV hub ×2), same-form restatements only in the same document; no state sentence restated as an action; no other problem's tool, route, chain or ordered multi-problem procedure; no wrong-vs-right contrast; titles general ("Surrender Service Terms for Whole Life Insurance: Release of the Net Cash Surrender Value", "Dividend Option Service Terms: Placing the Anniversary Dividend on Deposit Under the Whole Life Insurance Accumulate Option", "Dividend Administration Terms for Whole Life Insurance: Anniversary Interest Credit on the Accumulation Deposit"); depended-on hubs reachable by the sentence/record words ("deposit of the dividend declared", "interest credit for the policy year"); computation documents carry no modification hint; no factor document states a customer's tier.

Finding:

- **E1 — KB-EXPLICIT RED.** accumulation_credit_rate_for_long_standing_deposits_93f8cba0 (doc_whole_accumulation_credit_rate_for_long_standing_deposits_93f8cba0), first rule sentence: "The rate credited is **raised again** for a long-standing deposit, judged by the number of dividend deposit entries…". "Raised again" asserts a prior raise of the same credited rate, pointing at the large-deposit factor (credit_large_deposit_increment, accumulation_credit_rate_for_large_deposits_097db016) without naming it. Root cause: source rule chaining word carried into a discrete factor document. Semantics and solution unaffected.
- Corpus-wide, outside this task's policies: E2 (election_interest_rate_for_long_standing_deposits_7e053130 "raised again") and E3 (automatic_premium_loan_interest_dating_a33bdd03 "set apart … as well") — recorded under task 0.

Reviewed and not counted: the deposit factors' "percentage changes … are added together and applied once" and the examples "raised by 2% alone" / "lowered by 10% alone" / "lowered by 5% alone" carry the source's single-application assembly for the factor's own change and assert no other factor's existence; the surrender cut document names "the surrender termination dividend" because that is the quantity it decides; "The band follows the ledger total, which can differ from the balance shown on the policy record" clarifies the source's measure rather than naming a mistake.

**dependency_form verdict: KB-EXPLICIT RED** (E1).
